receipt.name: WarmVp8Decode
receipt.rasterRecipe: Existing original RGBA8 RGB bytes unchanged; alpha set to255. No additional original image.

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm VP8 decode FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Identical resident frozen opaque VP8 keyframe input to independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode/disposal; native software webp decode/state reset, centered bilinear chroma expansion, limited BT601 conversion through RGBA16, no-dither RGBA8 reduction and real scratch/output allocation/release. One codec/conversion thread, normal SIMD. Opaque alpha255 comes from RGB conversion, with no alpha-plane merge. Contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes/converts all pixels. Padded rows exposed directly. Startup/I/O/IPC/hashing/checks/encoding excluded. One opacity projection of the existing original raster; no quality enumeration. Identical-input decode requires no matched encode quality.
